description: This Dart source file defines a Supabase configuration class for initializing and managing a Supabase client, including URL validation, connection checks, retries with exponential backoff, and connection messaging.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A class providing configured initialization, URL validation, and connection management for Supabase service integration in a Flutter app.

methods.description: Validates the format of the Supabase URL, checking for correct scheme, domain, and URI structure.
